cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Structured knowledge base (crop calendars, fertilizer rates, agrochemical registrations) plus retrieval over Nigerian extension bulletins grounds every answer in verifiable agronomic fact rather than model recall, targeting extension agents and agrodealers operating fully offline.
